Formula getBin(position, start, end) = (position - start) * RESOLUTION / (end - start) with u32 division (floor). A live slot u -> v adds 1 (atomically) to cell getBin(order[u]) * RESOLUTION + getBin(order[v]): rows are source positions, columns are target positions, and slots whose positions fall outside the window [start, end) are dropped. Counts are exact integers, so the matrix does not depend on thread order; with fewer bins than nodes, each bin covers several consecutive matrix positions.
